decisions.reason: Cites both host files to separate clipboard-text draft/Occurrence coordinates from detect-text spans used by both verbs, with a chip as one U+FFFC versus its full clipboard form, and plain text unchanged.

Locates the draft.length span in add, explains that the coordinates coincide in an empty composer and overshoot the detect text after a chip, so insertReference returns false and triggers the misleading toast; rejects the idea of a real race.

Traces the unconverted offset/length going to consumeToken, the ignored false result, the unconditional records.delete, and the dock rendering unavailable for a live occurrence with no record; ties this to the same mismatch.

Derives subtracting (length-1) per preceding chip, applies it at the insert end using the fresh snapshot and at removal with a one-character detect span, keeps the revision guard, and deletes the record only when consumption succeeds.
Plans successive pastes with both chips present, removal of a middle chip among three with survivors checked across composer, dock and records, plus last-chip, stale-guard and re-paste variants.
